813-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-8319.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

222-527-7730-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7730-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

6351-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6351-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

4279-5332-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5332-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4881-5726-6909.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5726-6909.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by {U} plus an additional {3} to choose its second mode, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

654-864-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-864-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-864-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4050-6259-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Samut.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-6097.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4067-6254-6480-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-6254-6480-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

313-1777-7487.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Zealous Lorecaster, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Zealous Lorecaster from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4613-5310-5477-5627-7175.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7175.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with five +1/+1 counters on it

1597-7282-7340.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-7286.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

985-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
985-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

465-5987-6797.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

7124-7130.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk or Volatile Arsonist.
7124-7130.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Volatile Arsonist as attackers.
Volatile Arsonist triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
7124-7130.notes: Volatile Arsonist must be on the battlefield. This combo won't function with Dire-Strain Anarchist.

1114-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1114-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Wrenn and Realmbreaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2459-4053-6798-6989.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

579-4222.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}, and Freed from the Real is attached to that creature.
579-4222.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

2511-2558-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

3062-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Pir.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3062-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

654-1479-3534-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-3534-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1974-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Gargantuan on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Quicksilver Gargantuan do not have summoning sickness.
1974-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

2781-4605-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
2781-4605-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

708-2210-2459-5231.notablePrerequisites: Mirrormade is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2210-2459-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's last ability by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {R}.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

3398-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least ten permanents of any one color on the battlefield.
An opponent cannot block Rith or Hellkite Charger.
3398-3973-4050.description:
Declare Rith and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least ten 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Rith and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Saprolings, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least ten 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
If there are at least eleven permanents of any color on the battlefield, this combo nets infinite Saproling tokens and colored mana.

618-1953-3057.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
618-1953-3057.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster with haste.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Bloodthirster token.
Deal combat damage with a Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2019-2034-2773-2906.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Rakdos.
2019-2034-2773-2906.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to command zone.
Repeat.

2782-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{W}{U}{B}, plus additional mana dependent on how many creatures have died this turn and commander tax
2782-4050.description:
Cast Nevinyrral by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax.
Nevinyrral enters the battlefield.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nevinyrral, adding {1}.
Decline to pay for Nevinyrral's leave the battlefield trigger.
Resolve Nevinyrral's ETB trigger, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that died this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all Zombie tokens, adding {1} for each.
Repeat.

45-1309-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
45-1309-1987-2510.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
